name: chamber-5f93f5f3-blind22-ots
instr:
# segmentio/chamber: diagnosing wrong secret output, search and tag behaviour without a test suite

This is a command line tool that keeps a service's secrets in a cloud account and hands them back to people and to programs, and it is now wrong in a great many places at once. Nothing about the cloud services changed and nothing about how I invoke it changed. The repository has received 22 separate undocumented edits. What follows is everything I have been able to observe from the outside, grouped by what I was doing at the time.

Getting a service's secrets out in a form a shell can consume is broken three ways at once. A single secret named foo holding bar comes out as foo="bar" rather than FOO="bar", so the names are no longer upper-cased. When there is more than one secret, only one assignment line reaches the output and the rest vanish, with no error for the missing ones. Any value containing a backslash, a double quote or a dollar sign comes back with each of those characters replaced by the two characters backslash and n, so a value that is itself wrapped in quotes is emitted with backslash-n where the quotes were rather than escaped quotes; a value containing a real line break gets a backslash followed by a real line break rather than backslash-n, while carriage returns and exclamation marks behave as they have.
